title: wagyu.xyz unfairness — claimed by whitearmor
description:
Other · wagyu.xyz runs two rigged systems, both proven by the evidence:

1. Rigged coinflip. The site advertises "48% win chance, 4% house edge" (coinflip-public-claim.txt, coinflip-public-terms.json), but server settings aimed for a 4.00% expected edge and the distribution of outcomes is measurably shifted against players: of 2,852 provably-fair-verified flips, 1,417 fell in the 0-48000 band versus 1,325
